The '''Trigdale Metallurgy and Vaufthau Processing Industries Pressure''' was the headquarters for [[Trigdale Metallurgy]]'s and [[Vaufthau Processing Industries]]' operations on [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. As second rights-holders, they were required to share a single [[pressure]] complex. Security was provided by [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]].
